app.label: Get the app
app.title: Same account on your phone
app.body: The SimpleFit app signs in with this account. Store links will appear here once it's released.

plan: Training with your coach is always free. Pro adds deeper analytics, AI insights and video — never social features.

tour.failed: We couldn't save that. Check your connection and try again.

home.title: Start here
home.body: Home is where every day starts: your setup steps now, then your next class and your week once you train.

board.title: Your Live Board
board.body: Your sessions will build one board of gyms, partners and coaches, the same board as on your phone. It starts empty and fills in as you train.

camp.title: Fight camp, week by week
camp.body: Fight camps will be planned here: a fight date, phases, rounds per week, sparring load and your weight corridor. Camp planning isn't open yet.

progress.title: See your progress
progress.body: Rounds per week, training mix and effort will show here once you log training. Only you and your coach will see this page.

people.title: Your people
people.body: Community will show trainings friends choose to share — no ads, no follower counts. Discover will find partners, coaches and gyms. My profile is what others see.

market.title: Coaches, gyms and programs
market.body: Personal training, gym memberships, programs and events will be offered here, with checkout through a secure payment provider. Nothing is on sale yet.

week.title: Your week and your chats
week.body: Calendar will layer classes, training, sparring and camp tasks. Messages will be where your coach, your gym and training partners reach you.

privacy.title: You decide who sees what
privacy.body: Weight and coach notes are private by default. Profile visibility, notifications, sign-in and connected apps will be managed here.

workspace.title: One account, every role
workspace.body: This is your personal fighter space, on the one account you use for every role. Joining a coach's team or a gym's staff will never need a second sign-in, and your log stays yours.

done.title: You know your way around
done.body: Replay the tour any time from Take the tour. Your setup steps open as their features arrive.
